The M-mode boot stub delegates supervisor interrupts and S-mode exceptions through medeleg and mideleg, installs stvec, opens S-mode memory with a PMP NAPOT entry, enables counters through mcounteren, probes menvcfg.STCE for Sstc, then drops to S-mode with sret. The scheduler then runs entirely in S-mode on the delegated supervisor timer interrupt through stimecmp, with no M-mode involvement after boot.
